description: Work out the melt (scrap) value in pounds of gold jewellery or any gold item from its weight and carat or fineness, at Hopi's live mid-market gold price (updated hourly). Optionally compares a buyer's offer with the melt value. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/gold-value-calculator/

fineness.description: Purity in parts per 1,000 of pure gold, such as 916.7 or 999.9. Used instead of carat when given.

offer.description: Optional: a buyer's offer in pounds, to compare with the melt value

unit.description: Unit of the weight: g (grams, the default), ozt (troy ounces), dwt (pennyweights), oz (ordinary ounces, as kitchen scales show) or tola

weight.description: Weight of the item, in the chosen unit

name: hopi_gold_value_calculator

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Gold value calculator
